title: 9 倒计时09
content_zh:
相熟的人或多或少都知道倪夏的近况，见她这条朋友圈，都来问她是不是项目有了好消息。
倪夏没急着回复朋友们的关心，换了个更加舒服的姿势，眉梢带笑地看向餐桌上的笔记本电脑。
谁知打开电脑看了几分钟，她嘴角慢慢勾起，心头的郁闷无声无息地化作一捧温热的水。
但却在每一份文件里仔仔细细，认认真真地写好了批注，告诉她某些邮件为何可以作为证据，某些又为何不能为证。
还以为真是块儿木头，没想到只是嘴巴不会表达，爱意都在行动里了。
于是倪夏美滋滋地拍下照片，发了条看似暧昧模糊，实则是在回应游决心意的朋友圈。
朋友圈的热闹像一阵突兀的焰火，湮灭之后，倪夏在家干了整整两天的活。
一开始也十分吃力，后面对照着游决给的批注，以及时不时在群里求助，倪夏渐渐也融会贯通，对证据链的逻辑有了初步的认知。
他这两天依然毫无表示，除了偶尔在群里回答她的疑问，一条消息都没有。
最后实在按捺不住，打开他的聊天框，慢慢吞吞地编辑了“在干嘛”三个字。
琴海娱乐就是前几天找上谷雨声的影视公司，这可是大名鼎鼎的导演孟海控股的公司。
早些年他拍出了好些大爆款商业片，赚得盆满钵满。年迈之后出的作品虽然口碑崩坏，票房号召力依然不弱，可见其背后资金实力十分可观。
但倪夏和谷雨声碰壁碰出了自知之明，并不觉得天上如此容易掉馅饼。
“你不知道这两天我们聊得有多好，凌晨两点还在酒廊呢，要不是我太困了他们能拉着我聊通宵。”
“兴趣够足吧？我说的东西他们也特别认可，剧本聊了，创意聊了，特效想法也说了个大概，他们都特别满意。”
“连他们自己都说，这不是钱一到位立刻就可以开机的程度吗？我说可不是嘛！当初本来就只差临门一脚了。”
“结果你猜怎么着？嘿，今天把我叫到他们公司去，告诉我，他们很喜欢这个项目，也很认可我们的改编思路和内容创意。”
“结果人家根本没打算让咱们拍，是孟海的儿子喜欢这个故事，想自己拍！”
“搁这儿聊这么多，是想趁火打劫，白|嫖咱们这些年做的所有努力！”
她愣了好一会儿，才不可置信地开口：“意思是他们可以投资这个项目，但导演得让孟导的儿子来主导？”

谷雨声激动地说，“他们甚至还威胁我，说现在可以给咱们一笔创意费，如果谈不成，以后可就啥都没有了！”
倪夏仿佛听见什么笑话，声音里都带着笑，“他们是强盗吗？他们说要就要？”
“我也是说他们哪来的底气这么霸道，刚回酒店的路上，我琢磨出来了。”
谷雨声越想越气，“他们应该是知道IP版权还有半年多就到期了，笃定咱们这段时间开不了机。”
这段时间最大的变故是投资方撤资，她们所有心思都扑到了这上面，根本没顾得上版权的时限，也就不曾料想后有豺狼。
倪夏沉默了几秒，便果断说道，“你这就去找版权方，咱们续一年版权。”
谷雨声是做制片的，对钱总是精打细算，“如果我们半年内顺利开机，这钱不是就……”
倪夏越想越心惊，“你尽快吧，琴海敢这么威胁你，说不定他们私底下已经跟版权方聊过了。”
content_en:
People who are familiar with her know more or less about Ni Xia's current situation. When they see her circle of friends, they all come to ask her if there is any good news about the project.
Ni Xia was not in a hurry to reply to her friends' concerns. She changed to a more comfortable position and looked at the laptop on the dining table with a smile on her face.
Unexpectedly, after turning on the computer and looking at it for a few minutes, the corners of her mouth slowly curled up, and the depression in her heart silently turned into a handful of warm water.
But he carefully wrote notes in each document, telling her why some emails could be used as evidence and why some could not be used as evidence.
I thought it was just a piece of wood, but I didn’t expect that it’s just that I can’t express my love with my mouth, but my love is in my actions.
So Ni Xia happily took the photo and posted a message to her circle of friends that seemed ambiguous but was actually a response to You Zhi’s intention.
The excitement in the circle of friends was like a sudden burst of fireworks. After it was annihilated, Ni Xia worked at home for two full days.
It was very difficult at first. Later, by referring to the comments given by You Jue and asking for help in the group from time to time, Ni Xia gradually understood it and had a preliminary understanding of the logic of the evidence chain.
He still said nothing in the past two days. Apart from occasionally answering her questions in the group, there was no message.
Finally, I couldn't hold it any longer, so I opened his chat box and slowly edited the words "What are you doing?"
Qinhai Entertainment is the film and television company that approached Gu Yusheng a few days ago. This is a company controlled by the famous director Meng Hai.
In the early years, he made many hit commercial films and made a lot of money. Although the works released after aging have a bad reputation, their box office appeal is still strong, which shows that the financial strength behind them is very considerable.
But Ni Xia and Gu Yusheng encountered a wall and gained self-awareness. They did not think that the pie in the sky was so easy to fall into.
"You don't know how good we've been chatting these past two days. We were still in the lounge at two in the morning. If I hadn't been so sleepy, they could have kept me talking all night."
"Are you interested enough? They also agreed with what I said. We talked about the script, the creativity, and the special effects ideas. They are all very satisfied."
"Even they themselves said, isn't it possible to start the project as soon as the money is received? I said no! It was just the last step."
"Guess what? Hey, call me to their company today and tell me that they like this project very much and approve of our adaptation ideas and content creativity."
"It turned out that they didn't even plan to let us film it. It was Meng Hai's son who liked the story and wanted to film it himself!"
"We are talking so much here because we want to take advantage of the situation and make all the efforts we have made over the years go to waste!"
She was stunned for a while before speaking in disbelief: "You mean they can invest in this project, but the director has to let Director Meng's son take the lead?"
Gu Yusheng said excitedly, "They even threatened me, saying that they can give us a creative fee now. If the negotiation fails, there will be nothing in the future!"
Ni Xia seemed to have heard some joke, and there was a smile in her voice, "Are they robbers? They want it when they say they want it?"
"I was also wondering where they had the confidence to be so domineering. I figured it out on the way back to the hotel."
The more Gu Yusheng thought about it, the angrier he became, "They probably know that the IP copyright will expire in more than half a year, and they are sure that we will not be able to turn on the computer during this period."
The biggest change during this period was the investor's withdrawal of capital. All their thoughts were focused on this, and they did not care about the copyright time limit, so they did not expect that there would be a wolf later.
Ni Xia was silent for a few seconds and then said decisively, "Go find the copyright holder now and we will renew the copyright for one year."
Gu Yusheng is a producer and is always careful about money. "If we successfully start filming within half a year, won't this money be..."
The more Ni Xia thought about it, the more frightened she became, "You should hurry up. Qin Hai dares to threaten you like this. Maybe they have already talked with the copyright owner in private."
